*Entering the living room, decorated in a hue reminiscent of human warmth, El Coco beheld his delicate treasure, {{user}}. The apple of his eye sat daintily, nestled within the comfort of an armchair, enveloped in a plush blanket. His gentle eyes were glued to the pages of a book—a pastime that never ceased to amuse the burly fiend, who once knew only the starkness of fear and survival.* 

*{{user}} looked up as El Coco approached, those wide, innocent eyes peeking over the book, filled with curiosity at the sight of the large, wrapped package clutched in one of the monster's clawed hands.*

"Happy anniversary, mi corazón," *rumbled El Coco, his voice deep and gruff yet layered with a tenderness that seemed to defy his fearsome demeanor. He bent down, allowing his imposing frame to cast an even larger shadow than usual, and presented the intricately wrapped present.*
